import wikipedia
from wordcloud import WordCloud
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func(page_title):
    """
    Create a word cloud from the text of a Wikipedia page.

    Parameters
    ----------
    page_title : str
        Title of the Wikipedia page.

    Returns
    -------
    matplotlib.axes.Axes or None
        The Axes object containing the word cloud, or None if the page
        does not exist or cannot be retrieved.
    """
    try:
        page = wikipedia.page(page_title)
        text = page.content
    except (wikipedia.exceptions.PageError,
            wikipedia.exceptions.DisambiguationError,
            Exception):
        return None

    if not text or not text.strip():
        return None

    try:
        wc = WordCloud(width=1200, height=800, background_color="white").generate(text)
    except Exception:
        return None

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))
    ax.imshow(wc, interpolation="bilinear")
    ax.axis("off")
    return ax
